content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], How can I use this with [product_name]? I have a [product_name] connected to my PC and am able to ping it. I've installed Python 3.5.2 and successfully executed the code, resulting in the following output. Could you please advise? ****************************************************************** Operating System: nt Path to DLL: C:\Python\[product_name]/libnodave.dll ****************************************************************** - Attempt to open connection - Port Handle N.O.K. - Interface Handle: 46599688 - Adapter Initialization OK - Connection Handle: 46605064 - Result: -1 - Read: Please establish connection via CONNECT - Write - Read: Please establish connection via CONNECT - Connection to PLC terminated ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from python, libnodave and logo oba7.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to set up communication between a [product_name] module and a PC using Python 3.5.2, and has configured the necessary DLL. While the device can be pinged and the initial steps appear successful, read and write operations fail due to a missing connection setup phase. The messages indicate the need for a proper CONNECT command before accessing the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to establish a programmatic connection using Python to the [product_name] device and perform read/write operations successfully.
